columns.name: INDEX_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Index, usually alias.

columns.name: INDEX_COMMON_ALIAS
columns.description: Common alias of the Index. Same alias will be used for different versions of the same index. For Initial version, it would be same as INDEX_NAME.

columns.name: INDEX_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the index

columns.name: INDEX_NAME_OSCS
columns.description: Name of the index from OSCS perspective

columns.name: INDEX_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Index - to be used to determine if the index needs to be synced to Elastic or not.

columns.name: INDEX_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Index - like data, security etc

columns.name: TO_INDEX_NAME
columns.description: Index name to which current index needs to be switched or duplicated to.

columns.name: INDEX_METADATA
columns.description: Metadata of the Index in JSON format.

columns.name: METADATA_CUSTOMIZATION
columns.description: Customization information of the index metadata in JSON format

columns.name: INDEX_METADATA_CUSTOMIZED
columns.description: Customized metadata of the index in JSON format, includes base and customization info.

columns.name: INDEX_METADATA_APPLIED
columns.description: Applied metadata of the index in JSON format, includes base and customization that is applied to the oscs.

columns.name: METADATA_MAX_DEPTH
columns.description: Depth of the Index Metadata JSON - to be used to lookup attributes till that level

columns.name: INDEX_DEFINITION
columns.description: Elastic Search definition of the Index.

columns.name: P2T_PLAN
columns.description: plan that specifies what needs to be done during p2t for elastic index.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATE
columns.description: Used to Process (like initialIngest etc) State in JSON format

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT
columns.description: Business object which is used for data retrieval and data ingestion.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Seed data file from which the row originates.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
